description: Land Acquisition - Morawaka, Kotapola D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a land acquisition notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the government's intention to acquire a specific plot of land (Bogathugahahena) for public purposes. It contains detailed property descriptions, boundaries, lot numbers, and information about the landowner, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
